1981-2415-5931-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Funeral Room and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-8175.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Edgar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

512-7014-7066.easyPrerequisites: Avatar Kyoshi and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
512-7014-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Avatar Kyoshi, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-7014-7066.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Avatar Kyoshi's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

240-3899-4742-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

1742-5078-5741.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1172-7441.description:
Cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Fireball by paying {R} and all remaining available mana, dealing a large amount of damage divided among a set number of targets.
1172-7441.notes: The more life you have, the more damage you will deal. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Comet Storm. Comet Storm's multikicker can be used to add targets as needed.

2595-6798--5.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 2.

4052-5078-5231-7028.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirits enter, Kindred Discovery triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards, including Sensei's Divining Top.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

222-527-997-4742.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-997-4742.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

997-1687-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
997-1687-5972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

930-5315-6871-6879.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1477-3685-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
1477-3685-6747.description:
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {0} due to Sami.
When Spine of Ish Sah enters, its first ability triggers, targeting either a permanent an opponent controls or itself if an opponent doesn't control a targetable permanent.
Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah.
If you targeted Spine of Ish Sah in step 2, the ability will fizzle due to having no legal target.
Spine of Ish Sah's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Extruder ability from step 3.
Resolve the Spine of Ish Sah trigger from step 2, if applicable.
Repeat from step 1.

681-5412-5478-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5412-5478-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3239-5220-6900.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

874-1329-3152.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1329-3152.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Delif's Cone.
Cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Delif's Cone by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

222-527-5256-5295.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5256-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2493-4871-5231-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
2493-4871-5231-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Archaeomancer and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Archaeomancer, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

requires.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blcoked and killed by an opponent

1849-3259--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1849-3259--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

2018-4053-5147.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature that does not have flying.
2018-4053-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature without flying.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

803-3767-3918-5116.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
803-3767-3918-5116.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Sliver" chosen.
803-3767-3918-5116.description:
Activate Trazyn using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2351-4639-6240.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Topan Ascetic by tapping a blue creature you control except Unctus.
The creature triggers, causing you to loot.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Topan Ascetic ability.
Repeat.

2061-4872-5913.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

586-2921-5626-6112.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Fumulus's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Insect and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1799-2579-2701-4050-4477.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa, adding one mana of any color.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Greenwarden of Murasa from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

3384-4067-5611.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Sliver that does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
3384-4067-5611.description:
Activate a Sliver by tapping it and discarding a card, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the Sliver.
Repeat.

2837-3259-5500.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control.
You control any number of other untapped creatures with total power 4 or greater.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2837-3259-5500.description:
Activate Seraphic Steed's saddle ability by tapping any number of other creatures with power 4 or more, causing it to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Seraphic Steed and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

2035-2292-2523.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gollum.
When Gollum dies, it and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a  nonlegendary token copy of Gollum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Gollum trigger from step 2, causing the Ring to tempt you, and for the Gollum token to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2474-3011-3946.easyPrerequisites:
Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Each opponent has a life total of 2 or greater.
2474-3011-3946.description:
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal damage to each opponent equal to 3/2 their life total, and causing it to deal no damage to you due to Glacial Chasm.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1479-3257-4862.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3257-4862.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Omnath, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Omnath trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

65-717-2628-2993-3855.description:
Activate Remote Isle's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Remote Isle, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Remote Isle trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Stoic Builder.
Stoic Builder enters the battlefield, returning Remote Isle from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

70-5141.description:
Cast Balancing Act by paying {2}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Teferi's Protection by paying {2}{W}, causing all permanents you control to phase out.
Resolve Balancing Act, causing each opponent to sacrifice all their permanents as you control no permanents that aren't phased out.
